description: This file defines a utility enum 'GatewayPayloadDecoding' that provides static methods to decode JSON payloads of type 'AnyCodable' into Swift types conforming to 'Decodable'. It simplifies encoding and decoding operations within the application.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a payload of type 'AnyCodable' into a specified 'Decodable' type using JSON encoding and decoding.

methods.name: decodeIfPresent
methods.description: Decodes an optional payload of type 'AnyCodable' into a specified 'Decodable' type, returning nil if the payload is nil.
